summary: Behind cover, Lucien Tosselwrench waits while you carry cog #5 to Lotwil Veriatus.

sections.title: Behind Cover
sections.body: Lucien Tosselwrench gives you the cog for Lotwil Veriatus. Then he waits behind cover and welcomes you to join him. Lotwil is still bent over the shackles when you arrive. Without looking up, he holds out his hand and waggles his fingers for the cog.

sections.title: Making History
sections.body: Lotwil takes the cog and calls it perfect. He tells you to stand back as he prepares to make more history. Then he carries on working feverishly.

faq.q: Who hands over the cog for Lotwil?
faq.answer: Lucien Tosselwrench gives you cog #5 to carry to Lotwil Veriatus.
Lucien heads behind cover and welcomes you to join him.

faq.q: What is Lotwil doing when you bring the cog?
faq.answer: Lotwil is working on a set of shackles. Without looking up, he holds out his hand and waggles his fingers impatiently for the cog.
